thread:
Anya K.: dropping a compact Figma iteration for org-access onboarding — focuses: roles matrix density, invite modal flow, and SSO placement. PTAL before today's sync. https://figma.com/file/xxxxx :eyes:
Sam R.: looked — nice declutter. quick note: role chips now wrap weirdly at 320px, looks like a layout jump when you resize the drawer.
Michael L.: +1 on wrap. also the SSO toggle sits visually next to the 'Add member' CTA — feels like an action toggle. can we separate with a labelled divider or move it into a settings row?
Jess T.: audit log breadcrumb — current mock has "Org > Audit" then a left chevron that only collapses the panel. users expect it to navigate back to Members list. small but confusing for keyboard users.
design-bot: uploaded image preview (screenshot-roles-compact.png) and accessibility report: contrast for secondary text (light gray #9aa0a6 on white) fails AA for 14px.
Sam R.: hmm yeah. we should bump secondary to #6b7280 or 600 weight for readability. also focus outline isn't visible when tabbing into role chips — missing outline on :focus-visible.
Anya K.: good catches. for SSO: idea — move SSO toggle into an affordance row under 'Auth & security' with a short help text: "SSO enforced for all invites". keeps invite modal minimal. thoughts?
Michael L.: that works. copy suggestion for the help text: "Enforce SSO for new members — existing sessions unaffected." shorter: "Enforce SSO for new members." keep tooltip for details.
Jess T.: about the invite modal: current microcopy uses "Create invite" and "Send" in two places. prefer consistent verb: either "Create and send invite" or just "Send invite". consistency helps screen reader announcements.
Sam R.: agree — prefer "Send invite". and add aria-live region for success toast: "Invite sent to X" so SR users get confirmation.
Anya K.: noted. accessibility checklist: contrast fix, focus-visible for chips and CTA buttons, aria-live for toasts, breadcrumbs should be real links with proper aria-current on active. I'll update Figma.
Michael L.: one more layout nit — roles matrix header density: suggested decreasing header padding by 6px to fit column controls on 1280px without horizontal overflow. keeps toolbar in view.
Jess T.: +1. can we also add a shortcut hint for power users: "Press / to open invite"? might be handy and low-visual-cost.
Sam R.: love that. make sure the keyboard shortcut is announced in the help panel.
Anya K.: OK I'll push a new frame with changes and ping. If nobody objects, I'll ship these to the dev ticket today. :+1:
Michael L.: go for it.
Jess T.: thanks — will run one quick a11y pass after update.
Sam R.: and I'll check responsive wrap behavior on mobile drawer.
Anya K.: thanks team — will update thread when done.
